participating-org.narrative: Center for Legal Consulting and Leg

LACEW is a legal consulting organization that was granted operation registration certificate No. 16/TP/DKHD-TT dated October 15, 2012. The Center operates on providing legal consultancy, sending lawyers to participate in legal proceedings to defend, represent, protect legitimate rights and interests of individuals and organizations; providing legal aid in accordance with the law. From 2012-2017, the Center provided legal support for 426 cases. In 2017 alone, the center provided legal advice to 138 cases, protecting legitimate rights and interests for women in 35 marriage and family, civil, labor, criminal cases.
